title: Fear of Cancer Recurrence in Genitourinary Cancer
brief_summary: To perform an analysis of independent predictors of fear of cancer recurrence in patients with malignant genitourinary diseases and their impact on quality of life and survival
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* histologically confirmed diagnosis of either prostate, urothelial cell, testicular or renal cell cancer
study_population: Patients with confirmed genitourinary malignant disease undergoing curative surgical treatment
